title: Exploring holistic face processing in the fusiform and occipital face area using incomplete faces.
summary: Face recognition is essential for human social life, and two core face areas have been identified in the human brain: the fusiform face area (FFA) and occipital face area (OFA). Previous studies have explored the functional division of the FFA and OFA in holistic face processing, using variations of whole faces where holistic processing was disrupted. However, a main prediction of holistic face processing (i.e., nonlinear integration of parts into wholes) lacks direct evidence. Here, we tested this prediction in the FFA and OFA by comparing their responses to incomplete versus complete faces. We generated novel facial fragments using AlexNet, a deep convolutional neural network (DCNN), and presented the facial fragments, their occluded counterparts, and complete face during fMRI scanning. Results revealed that the FFA exhibited higher activation for complete than incomplete faces, while the OFA showed comparable or higher activation for some incomplete faces than complete one. Moreover, the FFA's activation for the complete face was higher than the weighted average activation for some of its constituent incomplete face pairs, while this difference was not observed in the OFA. These results suggest that the FFA favors holistic processing and combines facial parts nonlinearly, whereas the OFA focuses on local parts and processes parts linearly. Our findings shed new light on the neural basis of holistic face processing and the functional division of the FFA and OFA in face recognition. The approach combining DCNNs with neuroimaging techniques can be extended to broader visual domains in future studies.

标题：利用不完整面孔探究梭状回面孔区与枕叶面孔区的整体性面孔加工
摘要：面孔识别对人类社交生活至关重要，人脑中已识别出两个核心面孔区域：梭状回面孔区（FFA）和枕叶面孔区（OFA）。以往研究通过破坏整体性加工的完整面孔变体，探讨了FFA和OFA在整体性面孔加工中的功能分工。然而，整体性面孔加工的一个核心预测（即部分非线性整合为整体）缺乏直接证据。本研究通过比较FFA和OFA对不完整面孔与完整面孔的反应，检验了这一预测。我们利用深度卷积神经网络（DCNN）AlexNet生成新颖的面部碎片，并在fMRI扫描中呈现面部碎片、其遮挡版本以及完整面孔。结果显示，FFA对完整面孔的激活高于不完整面孔，而OFA对某些不完整面孔的激活与完整面孔相当甚至更高。此外，FFA对完整面孔的激活高于其某些组成性不完整面孔对的加权平均激活，而OFA中未观察到这一差异。这些结果表明，FFA倾向于整体性加工并对面部部分进行非线性组合，而OFA侧重于局部部分并进行线性加工。我们的发现为整体性面孔加工的神经基础以及FFA和OFA在面孔识别中的功能分工提供了新的启示。将DCNN与神经影像技术相结合的方法未来可拓展至更广泛的视觉领域。
关键词：整体性面孔加工；梭状回面孔区；枕叶面孔区；深度卷积神经网络；功能磁共振成像

title: A neural marker of human face identity recognition across novel natural views following brief familiarisation.
summary: Our memory capacity for face identities is extremely impressive: neurotypical human adults can recognise thousands of faces, and novel face identities are automatically encoded every day. Yet, our ability to recognise briefly learned facial identities across novel viewing conditions is poorly documented. Here we combined electroencephalography (EEG) and Fast Periodic Visual Stimulation (FPVS) to provide an implicit objective neural marker of newly learned face identity recognition. Twenty-eight participants were familiarised with images of unknown individuals through brief semantic association and recognition tasks (about 7 min). Participants then viewed streams of natural images of variable unfamiliar face identities (six images per second; 6 Hz), with novel natural images of the previously familiarised identities appearing every fifth image (1.2 Hz). Frequency-domain analysis revealed significant neural response at 1.2 Hz harmonics over occipito-temporal regions, indicating automatic face identity recognition. Critically, this neural response was two times larger (100% increase) for briefly familiarised identities compared to the same images without familiarisation presented as control. These findings demonstrate that robust face identity memories can emerge following only brief familiarisation, and be implicitly measured by FPVS-EEG, offering promises for better assessment and understanding of face identity learning in both healthy individuals and clinical populations.

标题：短暂熟悉后自然新颖视角下人脸身份识别的神经标记
摘要：我们对人脸身份的记忆能力极其惊人：神经典型成人能够识别数千张面孔，且新的面孔身份每天都在被自动编码。然而，我们对短暂学习过的面孔身份在新颖观看条件下的识别能力仍缺乏充分记录。本研究结合脑电图（EEG）与快速周期视觉刺激（FPVS），提供了一种内隐的客观神经标记来反映新学习面孔身份的识别。二十八名参与者通过简短的语义联想与识别任务（约7分钟）熟悉未知个体的图像。随后，参与者观看由不同陌生面孔身份自然图像组成的流（每秒六张图像；6 Hz），此前熟悉过的身份的新颖自然图像每第五张出现一次（1.2 Hz）。频域分析显示，枕颞区在1.2 Hz谐波处存在显著神经反应，表明存在自动的面孔身份识别。关键的是，与未经过熟悉化的相同图像作为对照相比，短暂熟悉化身份的这一神经反应大两倍（增加100%）。这些发现表明，仅经过短暂熟悉化即可形成稳健的面孔身份记忆，并可通过FPVS-EEG进行内隐测量，为更好评估和理解健康个体与临床人群的面孔身份学习提供了前景。
关键词：面孔身份识别；脑电图；快速周期视觉刺激；内隐神经标记；熟悉化

title: To thine own self be true: interoceptive accuracy and interpersonal problems
summary:
Abstract
                Background
                Borderline Personality Disorder involves strong interpersonal disruptions, often associated with early maltreatment. However, the individual capacities which alter BPD-related interpersonal problems are unclear. Here, we examine two contributors to interpersonal functioning: interoceptive accuracy and parasympathetic activity. Interoceptive accuracy is the ability to correctly perceive body states, such as how quickly one’s heart is beating, and has been associated with emotional experience and various crucial social capacities. Similarly, parasympathetic activity is related to social processing and inhibition of impulses. As such, both may contribute to BPD interpersonal symptoms, albeit different types of interpersonal problems.
              
                Method
                Sixty-five individuals completed the Inventory of Interpersonal Problems and the Millon Clinical Multiaxial Inventory followed by a task to assess interoceptive accuracy, the heart rate monitoring task, in which participants counted their heartbeats while concurrent physiological data was recorded; and an assessment of vagal tone, used as an index of regulatory flexibility.
              
                Results
                Participants who reported poor interpersonal boundaries, consistent with borderline personality disorder styles, had worse interoception, whereas those high in aggression had lower vagal tone. Borderline personality symptoms overall were related to IA and significantly to vagal tone.
              
                Conclusions
                These findings suggest that interoceptive accuracy is associated with interpersonal problems, where people are overly influenced or enmeshed with others, possibly to compensate for the absence of their physical and emotional awareness.

标题：忠于自我：内感受准确性与人际关系问题
摘要：背景：边缘型人格障碍涉及严重的人际关系紊乱，通常与早期虐待经历相关。然而，影响BPD相关人际关系问题的个体能力尚不明确。本研究考察人际功能的两个影响因素：内感受准确性与副交感神经活动。内感受准确性是指正确感知身体状态（如心跳快慢）的能力，已被证实与情绪体验及多种关键社会能力相关。同样，副交感神经活动与社会加工和冲动抑制有关。因此，二者均可能对BPD人际症状有所贡献，尽管对应的人际问题类型可能不同。方法：65名个体完成了人际关系问题量表（Inventory of Interpersonal Problems）和米隆临床多轴量表（Millon Clinical Multiaxial Inventory），随后进行内感受准确性评估任务——心率监测任务，即参与者在记录同步生理数据的同时计数自己的心跳；并评估迷走神经张力，作为调节灵活性的指标。结果：报告人际关系边界不良（与边缘型人格障碍风格一致）的参与者内感受能力较差，而攻击性较高的参与者迷走神经张力较低。总体而言，边缘型人格障碍症状与内感受准确性相关，并与迷走神经张力显著相关。结论：这些发现表明，内感受准确性与人际关系问题相关，表现为个体过度受他人影响或与他人纠缠，可能是为了补偿其身体和情绪觉察的缺失。
关键词：内感受准确性；人际关系问题；边缘型人格障碍；迷走神经张力；情绪觉察

title: Cortical and subcortical predictive dynamics and learning during perception, cognition, emotion and action
summary: An intimate link exists between the predictive and learning processes in the brain. Perceptual/cognitive and spatial/motor processes use complementary predictive mechanisms to learn, recognize, attend and plan about objects in the world, determine their current value, and act upon them. Recent neural models clarify these mechanisms and how they interact in cortical and subcortical brain regions. The present paper reviews and synthesizes data and models of these processes, and outlines a unified theory of predictive brain processing.

标题：感知、认知、情绪与行动中的皮层及皮层下预测动力学与学习
摘要：大脑中的预测过程与学习过程之间存在密切联系。感知/认知过程与空间/运动过程利用互补的预测机制来学习、识别、注意和规划世界中的客体，确定其当前价值，并对其采取行动。近期的神经模型阐明了这些机制及其在皮层和皮层下脑区中如何相互作用。本文回顾并综合了这些过程的资料与模型，并概述了一个统一的预测性大脑加工理论。
关键词：预测加工；情绪；感知；认知；皮层-皮层下机制

title: Feeling Virtually Present Makes Me Happier: The Influence of Immersion, Sense of Presence, and Video Contents on Positive Emotion Induction
summary: Immersive technologies, such as Virtual Reality (VR), have great potential for enhancing users' emotions and wellbeing. However, how immersion, Virtual Environment contents, and sense of presence (SoP) influence emotional responses remains to be clarified to efficiently foster positive emotions. Consequently, a total of 26 participants (16 women, 10 men, 22.73 ± 2.69 years old) were exposed to 360-degree videos of natural and social contents on both a highly immersive Head-Mounted Display and a low immersive computer screen. Subjective emotional responses and SoP were assessed after each video using self-reports, while a wearable wristband collected continuously electrodermal activity and heart rate to record physiological emotional responses. Findings supported the added value of immersion, as more positive emotions and greater subjective arousal were reported after viewing the videos in the highly immersive setting, regardless of the video contents. In addition to usually employed natural contents, the findings also provide initial evidence for the effectiveness of social contents in eliciting positive emotions. Finally, structural equation models shed light on the indirect effect of immersion, through spatial and spatial SoP on subjective arousal. Overall, these are encouraging results about the effectiveness of VR for fostering positive emotions. Future studies should further investigate the influence of user characteristics on VR experiences to foster efficiently positive emotions among a broad range of potential users.

标题：虚拟临场感让我更快乐：沉浸感、临场感与视频内容对积极情绪诱发的影响
摘要：沉浸式技术（如虚拟现实，VR）在增强用户情绪与幸福感方面具有巨大潜力。然而，沉浸感、虚拟环境内容与临场感（SoP）如何影响情绪反应仍有待阐明，以便高效地培养积极情绪。为此，共26名参与者（女性16名，男性10名，年龄22.73±2.69岁）在高沉浸感头戴式显示器和低沉浸感电脑屏幕上观看自然内容与社会内容的360度视频。每次观看视频后，采用自我报告评估主观情绪反应与临场感，同时使用可穿戴腕带持续采集皮肤电活动和心率以记录生理情绪反应。研究结果支持沉浸感的附加价值：无论视频内容如何，在高沉浸感环境中观看视频后，参与者报告了更多积极情绪和更强的主观唤醒。除常用的自然内容外，研究结果还为社会内容在诱发积极情绪方面的有效性提供了初步证据。最后，结构方程模型揭示了沉浸感通过空间临场感对主观唤醒的间接效应。总体而言，这些结果对VR培养积极情绪的有效性具有鼓舞作用。未来研究应进一步探究用户特征对VR体验的影响，以在广泛潜在用户群体中高效地培养积极情绪。
关键词：虚拟现实；沉浸感；临场感；积极情绪；情绪诱发
